standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the compatible family of generic points.

core_obligations: Quasi-compact basis: the pullbacks of opens form a basis, and each of them is quasi-compact because a covering in the limit topology is in particular a covering in the profinite topology (proof lines 4856-4864)
Stability under intersections: the intersection of two basis opens is again a basis open, by choosing a common stage above the two (proof lines 4865-4868)

Sobriety: a closed irreducible subset has irreducible images at every stage, each with a unique generic point, and the compatible family of these points is a generic point of the subset (proof lines 4869-4873)
proof_roadmap: X = lim X_i（由 limits 引理），p_i: X → X_i 为投影；由 describe-limits 得基为 p_i^{-1}(U_i)。
p_i^{-1}(U_i) 准紧：其在极限拓扑中的开覆盖也是 profinite 拓扑（即积拓扑）中的开覆盖 ⇒ 由 X_i 有限（从而积准紧）得准紧。
两支基开之交：取 k ≥ i, j 与 U_k 使 p_i^{-1}(U_i) ∩ p_j^{-1}(U_j) = p_k^{-1}(U_k)。
sober：Z 闭不可约 ⇒ p_i(Z) 在有限 sober 空间 X_i 中不可约 ⇒ 唯一泛点 ξ_i；ξ = lim ξ_i 是 Z 的泛点（Z 闭故 ξ ∈ Z）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the inverse limit of a directed inverse system of finite sober topological spaces is spectral (author lemma at source lines 4850-4854, label lemma-directed-inverse-limit-finite-sober-spectral-spaces). The proof (source lines 4856-4874) exhibits a basis of quasi-compact opens given by pullbacks, checks that intersections of basis opens are again basis opens and produces a generic point of any closed irreducible subset as the compatible family of the generic points of its images (proof lines 4856-4873). The quasi-compactness of the basis opens and the generic point construction are the substance. H3.
